lines.zh: 我沿着田埂慢走，袖子扫着草。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge, my sleeves brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 我抱着手，慢慢踱过村口。
lines.en: Arms folded, I stroll past the village gate.

lines.zh: 我走在花丛边上，不敢踩。
lines.en: I keep to the edge of the flowers so as not to tread on them.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边抬头看蝴蝶。
lines.en: I walk with my head up, watching the butterflies.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，有蝶跟着我。
lines.en: Butterflies trail along the path I take.

lines.zh: 我挪着步子，怕惊动它们。
lines.en: I move my feet carefully so as not to startle them.

lines.zh: 我朝温室那边去，路上停两次。
lines.en: I head for the greenhouse, stopping twice on the way.
I walk slowly over to the fence.
Flower petals cling to my boots.

lines.zh: 我绕开一片花，多走了几步。
lines.en: I go around a patch of flowers, taking a few extra steps.
I carry a net over to the tree.

lines.zh: 我从这头走到那头，看了一圈。
lines.en: I walk from one end to the other, looking around.

lines.zh: 我站着，手里捏着一片叶。
lines.en: I stand holding a leaf.

lines.zh: 我把手张开，等蝴蝶落下。
lines.en: I open my hand and wait for a butterfly to land.

lines.zh: 我在看纸上的标本，很仔细。
lines.en: I am examining a pinned specimen closely.
I keep still so it does not fly off.
I am counting how many hatched today.

lines.zh: 我把罐子举到眼前，摇了摇。
lines.en: I lift a jar to my eye and give it a shake.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，怕吹到它。
lines.en: My breathing is light, so as not to blow on it.
I crouch by the flowers a long while.

lines.zh: 我把网卷起来，收进包里。
lines.en: I roll up my net and put it in my bag.

lines.zh: 我在等一只不肯落下的。
lines.en: I wait for one that will not settle.
One is resting on my cuff.

lines.zh: 我在这里只是个普通村民。
lines.en: Here I'm only an ordinary villager.

lines.zh: 我在听它们扇翅膀的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sound of their wings.
I lean on the fence, very quiet.
Would you like to see the butterflies? Keep your voice low.

lines.zh: 别急着抓，先看它们停哪。
lines.en: Do not grab; first see where they settle.
All my jars are empty.
That mesh is too coarse; it tears wings.

lines.zh: 这些叶子不能让蝶产卵。
lines.en: These leaves are not the ones they lay on.
Look over there; it has opened its wings.
They only live a little while.
Will you keep it or let it go?
I know the pattern on every kind.

lines.zh: 你别站太近，影子会吓着它。
lines.en: Do not stand too close; your shadow scares it.
I have some in bottles here.

lines.zh: 你要不要帮我看着这一片？
lines.en: Would you help me watch this patch?

lines.zh: 我把钉好的标本都收着。
lines.en: I keep all my pinned specimens.
Quieter; one is about to land.
One has landed on your shoulder; do not move.

lines.zh: 它们会自己在叶子上产卵。
lines.en: They lay their eggs on leaves by themselves.
The pattern on this one is rare.

lines.zh: 我等着它们从蛹里出来。
lines.en: I am waiting for them to come out of the cocoons.
I shield the jar and take the hit.
I frown and say nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的网撞掉了。
lines.en: That knocks my net to the ground.
I bend to pick up the net, slowly.
I hold the fence to steady myself.
A cut opens in my sleeve.
I press my shoulder and draw a breath.
Not here; you will step on the flowers.
I back out of the flower bed.
I glance at the wound, then at you.
You brought flowers; wonderful.

lines.zh: 那篮子里的叶子，给我看看。
lines.en: Let me see the leaves in that basket.
A smell of nectar; I caught it.
Keep your hand still and let it land.
Do you have an empty jar?
Is that flower garden yours?

lines.zh: 你把网收起来，蝶会来的。
lines.en: Put the net away; they will come.
Are you giving me one?

lines.zh: 花蜜的味道，是你带来的？
lines.en: Is that nectar smell from you?
That plant is blooming beautifully.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，罐子差点掉了。
lines.en: You bump me and my jar nearly falls.

lines.zh: 我护住手里的网，退了一步。
lines.en: I shield my net and step back.

lines.zh: 我扶住你的手臂，站住了。
lines.en: I catch your arm and steady myself.

lines.zh: 撞上时，一只蝶飞起来了。
lines.en: At the impact, a butterfly takes flight.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，我的袖子蹭到你。
lines.en: We brush past and my sleeve grazes you.
You step on the leaf by my foot.

lines.zh: 我被推得退了两步，还护着罐子。
lines.en: I stagger back two steps, still guarding the jar.

lines.zh: 相撞后，我赶紧看罐子有没有碎。
lines.en: After the bump, I check the jar first.
Do not knock into me; these are fragile.

lines.zh: 我们分开后，蝶都飞走了。
lines.en: After we part, the butterflies have all gone.
I have a home in the village.

lines.zh: 这件事，我没什么好说的。
lines.en: I have little to say about that.
I still have my flowers to watch.
That came out of nowhere.
I look down at the jar.
I do well enough on my own.
The butterflies keep me busy enough.
My flowers are not yet pollinated.
Do not say such things in the garden.
I step away and go back to the leaves.
I pinch it up carefully; it is very light.
I put it into an empty jar.
I pick up the leaf; there are eggs underneath.

lines.zh: 没职业的村民，也认得这个。
lines.en: Even a jobless villager knows this.
Do not squeeze this; it will break.

lines.zh: 我拾起网杆，检查有没有破。
lines.en: I pick up the net pole and check for holes.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的花收在篮里。
lines.en: I gather the fallen flowers into a basket.
I set down the tweezers and reach for paper.
I slip it into the specimen book.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看了看，放回去了。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and put it back.
That one; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 别动，它停在你的帽子上。
lines.en: Do not move; it is on your hat.
I note it on this page.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝那一丛走过去。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward that clump.
It is the one on your hand.
I raise the net, very gently.
I have not collected that pattern yet.
I watch the spot where it lands.
This one is worth keeping.

lines.zh: 我先不动，等它收起翅膀。
lines.en: I hold still and wait for it to fold its wings.

lines.zh: 我把手伸出去，掌心朝上。
lines.en: I reach out with my palm up.

lines.zh: 它在叶子背面，我看见了。
lines.en: It is on the underside of the leaf; I see it.

lines.zh: 我要小心，不能碰坏翅膀。
lines.en: I must be careful not to damage the wings.

lines.zh: 我把注意力放到那一只上。
lines.en: I fix my attention on that one.
This one flies slowly; that is easy.

lines.zh: 就是这一片花，它在里面。
lines.en: It is in this patch of flowers.
I follow it without running.

lines.zh: 它落在哪，我就在哪停下。
lines.en: Where it settles, I stop there.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪过去，一步一停。
lines.en: I shift over slowly, pausing at each step.
I have its flight path worked out.
I wait for it to settle itself.
I circle the flower bed.
It goes up into the tree and I look up.
I keep watching it without moving my feet.
It settles on the fence; good.
I am in no hurry; it will land eventually.
I raise the net and wait for the wind to drop.
It is behind me; I know.

lines.zh: 这几片叶子之间，它飞不出。
lines.en: Among these leaves it cannot get away.
The wings fold; it'll soon settle.
The moment it stops, I move.
I approach from the side, not blocking the light.
I count its wingbeats.
I wait for it to open its wings.

lines.zh: 我伸手一挡，没让你碰它。
lines.en: I put out an arm so you cannot touch it.
I push you, and you take two steps back.
I use the net pole to move your hand aside.
Do not crush it.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍在你手背上。
lines.en: I smack the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我扯住你的袖子往回拉。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and pull you back.
Not a heavy blow; only to stop you.
You stepped on the flowers; that is why I moved.
I shoulder you aside.

lines.zh: 我挡住花圃入口，别硬闯。
lines.en: I block the garden entrance; do not force it.
I raise a hand to shield that butterfly.
My block sends you back half a step.
I take your wrist without force.
The things here are not to be touched.
I push you out of the flower bed.
I bring the net pole across to block you.

lines.zh: 我蹲在花圃边上，一直在这儿。
lines.en: I was crouching by the flower bed all along.

lines.zh: 你走近，我才从叶后抬头。
lines.en: You come close and I look up from behind the leaves.

lines.zh: 我提着网从田那头过来。
lines.en: I come over from across the field with my net.

lines.zh: 我先放下罐子，才直起身。
lines.en: I set down my jar before standing up.

lines.zh: 我在村里住久了，你不常见我。
lines.en: I have lived here long; you seldom see me.

lines.zh: 我站起来，膝上落着碎叶。
lines.en: I stand, leaves falling from my knees.

lines.zh: 我从树后绕出来，手上是空的。
lines.en: I come round the tree with empty hands.

lines.zh: 我的袖子被花染了一点色。
lines.en: My sleeve is stained a little by the flowers.

lines.zh: 我正在摆标本，抬头看你。
lines.en: I am arranging specimens and look up at you.

lines.zh: 我推开门，屋里的蝶飞起来。
lines.en: I push the door open and the butterflies inside rise.
I nod at you without speaking.

lines.zh: 我把篮子放下，抖了抖手。
lines.en: I set down my basket and shake out my hands.
I straighten up out of the flowers, slowly.

lines.zh: 我手里还捏着一片带卵的叶。
lines.en: I am still holding a leaf with eggs on it.
This is where I often come.

lines.zh: 我早就听见你的脚步了。
lines.en: I heard your footsteps a while ago.

lines.zh: 我抬头时，一只蝶落在我鼻尖。
lines.en: As I look up, one lands on my nose.
I have been watching here all morning.
I beat at the flames, afraid for the flowers.

lines.zh: 我摔在田埂上，罐子碎了。
lines.en: I fall on the ridge and my jar breaks.

lines.zh: 我呛了水，抱着罐子爬上来。
lines.en: I choke on water and climb out holding the jar.

lines.zh: 气浪把标本册吹开了页。
lines.en: The blast flips open my specimen book.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的手臂，钉在篱笆上。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my arm and sticks in the fence.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，蝶全飞了起来。
lines.en: A spell sweeps past and every butterfly rises.
I forgot to eat, and my hands tremble.

lines.zh: 雷光照白了花圃，我护住眼。
lines.en: Lightning whitens the garden and I cover my eyes.

lines.zh: 虚空扯我，我抓着篱笆不松。
lines.en: The void pulls at me and I grip the fence.
